decision: Adopt configured private-pool ordered public-tree materialization in production new/resume, research-session construction and formal-profile reconstruction. Keep serial admission and existing serial core APIs; no algorithm/state/wire identity changes.
limitations: Two repeated observations per kind/thread count on one local 16-logical-CPU Windows machine, warm EHS cache, one Simple K32 tree. No confidence interval or cross-machine scaling guarantee.
Process time includes existing thread-dependent solving/evaluation and cannot all be attributed to new initialization.
Observed Windows lifetime peak working set is polled every 50ms; final unsampled interval may be omitted. Arena bytes are not a process RAM guarantee; temporary tree merge storage remains.
Fresh large-tree equality covers the full raw regret fingerprint, counters and 16 exported histories; core small real-Holdem tests separately cover every tree/arena/state field and checkpoint bytes.
Restored diagnostics are exact across tested threads but tiny deviator budgets are not strong BR/convergence evidence.
No equilibrium, exploitability, abstraction fidelity or balanced strategy-quality improvement is claimed from initialization speedup.
Serial preflight still costs about 30 seconds in the earlier phase benchmark; repeated formal-profile reconstruction and larger-machine scaling remain opportunities.

restoreOutputSummary.interpretation: Held-out gains cover two fixed candidate deviations per seat; the trained candidate is used where it retained an action and otherwise falls back to the main regret-greedy candidate. Deviator coverage in this document is training coverage, not held-out replay coverage. Node conditional action rates are self-normalized reach-weighted ratio estimates, are not claimed finite-sample unbiased, and represent a composite policy whenever their fallback reach-weight fraction is positive. These results are diagnostics, not a full best response, exploitability, or Nash certificate. Evaluation seeds are reported separately and are not selected or pooled.

retention: Full stdout/stderr remains under the retained run for every case, identified by SHA256. This tracked evidence summarizes per-hand rows with counts/statuses/content hashes; full-output canonical equality hashes were computed before summarization.
